description: A made-up test scenario: planning a dinner party menu with three courses.
title: Plan a dinner party
opening_line: Hi! I'm so glad we're planning this dinner party together. We need to pick a starter, a main course, and a dessert. Do you have any ideas?
closing_line: That's our whole menu, then. Thanks for planning this with me, it's going to be a lovely party!

participant.brief: You and your friend are hosting a dinner party. Plan the menu together.

constraints.text: One of the guests is vegetarian.

avatar.brief: You are planning a dinner party together with the user, a friend of yours. The two of you are hosting it.

constraints.text: One of the guests doesn't like spicy food.
You'd like a dessert you can make the day before.
